{"addr": "0x140c3d8c0", "comment": "Our name (65148). (character+0xC0, fullSave, out snapshot): fills the graph snapshot SaveState 63601 writes. First section = active states: walks the root behaviour graph's active nodes (behaviorGraph +152, 144-byte entries, node at +80), keeps hkbStateMachines (StaticClass), takes their clone (GetNodeClone 58359) and records the current state's name (states[GetStateIndex(+128 currentStateId)] +96), the machine and its active transitions (+176, count +184). A machine is recorded only if mid-transition, or its current state differs from its start state (+104), or +134 > 1, or the global byte_1420C7978 is set: machines resting in their start state are left out. So a snapshot right after PerformAction 38949 holds the outgoing state's machines while they blend, and is no reading of where the owner stays: the harness's live watch reads it at each moment (docs/re/systems/animation-replay-recovery.md). Read in IDA."}
